tasks.name: 新向量修复
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
// ═══ L0/L1/L2 向量纯后台定点清洗 + 自动静默补齐 + 词法缓存无损重置 ═══
// 特性：纯后台底层管道执行，无硬编码哈希，跨版本自适应动态寻址
// 修复：补全 L1/L0/L2 缺失向量的全面检测；修复底层 repairMissingChunks 传参导致的静默失败
(async () => {
  // ════════ 配置参数 ════════
  const ONLY_CHECK = 0; // 【只检测不修复】开关：true = 仅检测并输出诊断报告（不执行任何写入/删除/重置）；false = 自动检测并执行修复
  const CHECK_USER_HIDDEN_RESIDUAL = false; // 【检测隐藏楼层残留向量】开关：true = 扫描并清理已被用户手动隐藏楼层的残留切片与向量；false = 忽略隐藏楼层的残留切片与向量（跳过对此类楼层的残留检测与清理）

  if (window.__LWB_VECTOR_AUTO_REPAIRING__) {
    console.info('[Info] 向量后台自动修复任务正在进行中，跳过本次执行');
    return;
  }
  window.__LWB_VECTOR_AUTO_REPAIRING__ = true;

  const toast = (m, t = 'info', timeOut = 4000) => {
    window.toastr?.[t]?.(m, ONLY_CHECK ? '向量状态检测' : '向量后台修复', { timeOut });
  };

  try {
    const { getContext } = await import('/scripts/extensions.js');
    const ctx = getContext();
    const chatId = ctx?.chatId;
    const chat = ctx?.chat || [];
    if (!chatId || !chat.length) {
      toast('❌ 未打开有效聊天', 'error');
      return;
    }

    // ── 步骤 0：三级动态寻址宿主 CacheRegistry（去除哈希硬编码） ──
    const resolveHostCacheRegistry = async () => {
      if (window.xbCacheRegistry?.getDetail?.('storySummary')) {
        return window.xbCacheRegistry;
      }
      try {
        const loadedEntry = performance.getEntriesByType?.('resource')
          ?.find(e => /\/debug-core-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\.js/.test(e.name));
        if (loadedEntry) {
          const mod = await import(loadedEntry.name);
          if (mod?.t && (mod.t.getDetail?.('storySummary') || typeof mod.t.clear === 'function')) {
            return mod.t;
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}

      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/dist/manifest.json', { cache: 'no-cache' });
        if (resp.ok) {
          const manifest = await resp.json();
          const relPath = Object.keys(manifest.resources || {}).find(k => /^shared\/debug-core-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\.js$/.test(k))
            || manifest.entries?.['host/plugin']?.imports?.find(k => k.includes('debug-core'));
          if (relPath) {
            const mod = await import(`/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/dist/${relPath}`);
            if (mod?.t) return mod.t;
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}

      try {
        const resp = await fetch('/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/dist/host/plugin.js');
        if (resp.ok) {
          const text = await resp.text();
          const match = text.match(/\.\.\/shared\/(debug-core-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+\.js)/);
          if (match) {
            const mod = await import(`/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/dist/shared/${match[1]}`);
            if (mod?.t) return mod.t;
          }
        }
      } catch (_) {}

      return null;
    };

    let hostCacheRegistry = await resolveHostCacheRegistry();
    if (hostCacheRegistry) {
      window.xbCacheRegistry = hostCacheRegistry;
    }

    const BASE = '/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary';
    const [cs, ss, dg, svi, evi, ct, cfg, emb, dbMod, lex, crp, si] = await Promise.all([
      import(`${BASE}/vector/storage/chunk-store.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/storage/state-store.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/utils/vector-input-digest.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/state-vector-input.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/event-vector-input.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/chunk-text.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/data/config.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/utils/embedder.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/data/db.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/retrieval/lexical-index.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/chunk-repair.js`),
      import(`${BASE}/vector/pipeline/state-integration.js`),
    ]);

    const memoryDb = dbMod.db || dbMod;
    const chunksTable = dbMod.chunksTable || memoryDb.chunks;
    const chunkVectorsTable = dbMod.chunkVectorsTable || memoryDb.chunkVectors;
    const lexicalIndexTable = dbMod.lexicalIndexTable || memoryDb.lexicalIndex;

    if (hostCacheRegistry) {
      window.xbCacheRegistry = hostCacheRegistry;
    }

    // ── 阶段一：全量状态检测（损坏异常 + 缺漏向量） ──
    console.info('[Info] 正在执行全量向量状态校验...');
    const isUserHidden = (msg) => !!msg?.is_system && msg.xb_summary_hidden !== true;
    const vectorCfg = cfg.getVectorConfig();
    if (!vectorCfg?.enabled) {
      toast('❌ 向量检索未启用', 'error');
      return;
    }

    const currentFp = emb.getEngineFingerprint(vectorCfg);
    const meta = await cs.getMeta(chatId);
    const fpMismatch = Boolean(meta?.fingerprint && meta.fingerprint !== currentFp);

    const [storedChunks, chunkVecs, stateVecs, evVecs] = await Promise.all([
      cs.getAllChunks(chatId),
      cs.getAllChunkVectors(chatId),
      ss.getAllStateVectors(chatId),
      cs.getAllEventVectors(chatId),
    ]);

    const atoms = ss.getStateAtoms() || [];
    const events = ctx.chatMetadata?.extensions?.LittleWhiteBox?.storySummary?.json?.events || [];

    // 1. L1 检测（损坏 + 缺漏）
    const l1CorruptFloors = new Set();
    const l1CorruptChunkIds = [];
    for (const c of storedChunks) {
      const isFloorInvalid = !Number.isInteger(c.floor) || c.floor < 0 || c.floor >= chat.length;
      const isIdxInvalid = !Number.isInteger(c.chunkIdx) || c.chunkIdx < 0;
      const isIdMismatch = c.chunkId !== cs.makeChunkId(c.floor, c.chunkIdx);
      const isTextEmpty = typeof c.text !== 'string' || !c.text;

      if (isFloorInvalid || isIdxInvalid || isIdMismatch || isTextEmpty) {
        l1CorruptFloors.add(c.floor);
        l1CorruptChunkIds.push(c.chunkId);
      }
    }

    const storedChunksByFloor = new Map();
    for (const c of storedChunks) {
      if (!storedChunksByFloor.has(c.floor)) storedChunksByFloor.set(c.floor, []);
      storedChunksByFloor.get(c.floor).push(c);
    }

    const l1DriftFloors = [];
    const l1OutFloors = [];
    const l1UserHiddenResidualFloors = [];
    for (const [floor, list] of storedChunksByFloor.entries()) {
      if (floor >= chat.length) {
        l1OutFloors.push(floor);
        continue;
      }
      const msg = chat[floor];
      if (isUserHidden(msg)) {
        // 用户手动隐藏楼层：若开启参数且DB仍残留旧切片，归为隐藏残留
        if (CHECK_USER_HIDDEN_RESIDUAL && list && list.length > 0) {
          l1UserHiddenResidualFloors.push(floor);
        }
        continue;
      }
      const curChunks = ct.chunkMessage(floor, msg);
      if (curChunks.length !== list.length) {
        l1DriftFloors.push(floor);
        continue;
      }
      list.sort((a, b) => a.chunkIdx - b.chunkIdx);
      const isMismatch = curChunks.some((cur, idx) => {
        const stored = list[idx];
        return !stored || cur.chunkId !== stored.chunkId || cur.textHash !== stored.textHash;
      });
      if (isMismatch) l1DriftFloors.push(floor);
    }

    const chunkById = new Map(storedChunks.map(c => [c.chunkId, c]));
    const chunkVecById = new Map(chunkVecs.map(v => [v.chunkId, v]));

    const l1OrphanVecIds = chunkVecs.filter(v => !chunkById.has(v.chunkId)).map(v => v.chunkId);
    const l1StaleVecIds = [];
    for (const v of chunkVecs) {
      const c = chunkById.get(v.chunkId);
      if (!c) continue;
      if (v.sourceHash && v.sourceHash !== dg.inputDigest('chunk', c.text)) {
        l1StaleVecIds.push(v.chunkId);
      }
    }

    // ── L1 缺漏检测 ──
    const l1MissingChunkFloors = [];
    for (let f = 0; f < chat.length; f++) {
      const msg = chat[f];
      if (!msg || !msg.mes || isUserHidden(msg)) continue;
      const expected = ct.chunkMessage(f, msg);
      if (!expected || !expected.length) continue;
      if (!storedChunksByFloor.has(f) || !storedChunksByFloor.get(f).length) {
        l1MissingChunkFloors.push(f);
      }
    }
    const l1MissingVecChunkIds = storedChunks.filter(c => !chunkVecById.has(c.chunkId)).map(c => c.chunkId);

    // 2. L0 检测（损坏 + 缺漏）
    let l0FailedFloors = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < chat.length; i++) {
      const msg = chat[i];
      if (!msg || msg.is_user || isUserHidden(msg)) continue;
      const st = ss.getL0FloorStatus(i);
      if (st?.status === 'failed') l0FailedFloors++;
    }

    const atomById = new Map(atoms.filter(a => a?.atomId).map(a => [String(a.atomId), a]));
    const l0DanglingAtomIds = stateVecs.filter(v => !atomById.has(String(v.atomId))).map(v => v.atomId);
    const l0StaleAtomIds = [];
    const l0FloorMismatchAtomIds = [];

    for (const v of stateVecs) {
      const a = atomById.get(String(v.atomId));
      if (!a) continue;

      const isFloorOutOfBound = !Number.isInteger(v.floor) || v.floor < 0 || v.floor >= chat.length;
      const isFloorDiverged = v.floor !== a.floor;
      if (isFloorOutOfBound || isFloorDiverged) {
        l0FloorMismatchAtomIds.push(v.atomId);
      }

      const wantSrc = dg.inputDigest('state', a.semantic);
      const wantRel = dg.inputDigest('relation', svi.buildRAggregateText(a));
      if (v.sourceHash && (v.sourceHash !== wantSrc || (v.rVector && v.relationHash && v.relationHash !== wantRel))) {
        l0StaleAtomIds.push(v.atomId);
      }
    }

    // ── L0 缺漏检测 ──
    const stateVecAtomIdSet = new Set(stateVecs.map(v => String(v.atomId)));
    const l0MissingAtomIds = atoms.filter(a => a?.atomId && !stateVecAtomIdSet.has(String(a.atomId))).map(a => a.atomId);

    // 3. L2 检测（损坏 + 缺漏）
    const evById = new Map(events.filter(e => e?.id).map(e => [e.id, e]));
    const evVecById = new Map(evVecs.map(v => [v.eventId, v]));

    const l2DanglingEventIds = evVecs.filter(v => !evById.has(v.eventId)).map(v => v.eventId);
    const l2StaleEventIds = [];
    for (const v of evVecs) {
      const e = evById.get(v.eventId);
      if (!e) continue;
      const text = evi.buildEventVectorText(e);
      const wantHash = dg.inputDigest('event', text);
      const isHashMismatch = v.sourceHash && v.sourceHash !== wantHash;
      const isFpMismatch = v.fingerprint && v.fingerprint !== currentFp;
      if (isHashMismatch || isFpMismatch) {
        l2StaleEventIds.push(v.eventId);
      }
    }
    const l2MissingEvents = events.filter(e => e?.id && evi.buildEventVectorText(e) && !evVecById.has(e.id));

    // ── 【只检测不修复模式】直接输出诊断并退出 ──
    if (ONLY_CHECK) {
      const totalIssues = (fpMismatch ? 1 : 0)
        + l1DriftFloors.length + l1UserHiddenResidualFloors.length + l1OutFloors.length + l1CorruptChunkIds.length + l1MissingVecChunkIds.length + l1MissingChunkFloors.length + l1OrphanVecIds.length + l1StaleVecIds.length
        + l0FloorMismatchAtomIds.length + l0MissingAtomIds.length + l0DanglingAtomIds.length + l0StaleAtomIds.length + l0FailedFloors
        + l2MissingEvents.length + l2DanglingEventIds.length + l2StaleEventIds.length;

      console.info(`========== [向量检测报告] 异常项合计: ${totalIssues} (只读模式) ==========`);
      console.info(`[环境] 指纹状态: ${fpMismatch ? '❌ 模型变更' : '✅ 正常'} (${currentFp})`);
      console.info(`[L1] 漂移楼: ${l1DriftFloors.length} | 隐藏残留: ${CHECK_USER_HIDDEN_RESIDUAL ? l1UserHiddenResidualFloors.length : '已跳过检测'} | 越界楼: ${l1OutFloors.length} | 破损切片: ${l1CorruptChunkIds.length} | 缺向量块: ${l1MissingVecChunkIds.length} | 缺失切片楼: ${l1MissingChunkFloors.length} | 孤儿向量: ${l1OrphanVecIds.length} | 过期向量: ${l1StaleVecIds.length}`);
      console.info(`[L0] 楼层错位: ${l0FloorMismatchAtomIds.length} | 缺向量: ${l0MissingAtomIds.length} | 孤儿: ${l0DanglingAtomIds.length} | 过期: ${l0StaleAtomIds.length} | 提取失败楼: ${l0FailedFloors}`);
      console.info(`[L2] 缺向量事件: ${l2MissingEvents.length} | 孤儿事件向量: ${l2DanglingEventIds.length} | 过期: ${l2StaleEventIds.length}`);

      if (totalIssues > 0) {
        if (l1DriftFloors.length) console.info(`[明细] L1 正文漂移楼: ${l1DriftFloors.join(', ')}`);
        if (CHECK_USER_HIDDEN_RESIDUAL && l1UserHiddenResidualFloors.length) console.info(`[明细] L1 手动隐藏残留切片楼: ${l1UserHiddenResidualFloors.join(', ')}`);
        if (l1OutFloors.length) console.info(`[明细] L1 越界楼: ${l1OutFloors.join(', ')}`);
        if (l1CorruptFloors.size) console.info(`[明细] L1 破损切片楼: ${[...l1CorruptFloors].join(', ')}`);
        if (l1MissingChunkFloors.length) console.info(`[明细] L1 缺失切片楼: ${l1MissingChunkFloors.join(', ')}`);
        if (l0FloorMismatchAtomIds.length) console.info(`[明细] L0 错位原子ID: ${l0FloorMismatchAtomIds.slice(0, 10).join(', ')}${l0FloorMismatchAtomIds.length > 10 ? '...' : ''}`);
        if (l0MissingAtomIds.length) console.info(`[明细] L0 缺向量原子ID: ${l0MissingAtomIds.slice(0, 10).join(', ')}${l0MissingAtomIds.length > 10 ? '...' : ''}`);
        if (l2MissingEvents.length) console.info(`[明细] L2 缺向量事件ID: ${l2MissingEvents.map(e => e.id).slice(0, 10).join(', ')}`);
        toast(`🔍 向量检测: 发现 ${totalIssues} 处异常 (只读未修复，见控制台)`, 'warning', 6000);
      } else {
        console.info('[Info] 向量状态与切片全文100%一致，未检测到任何缺漏或异常');
        toast('✅ 向量状态全部正常 (只读模式)', 'success', 4000);
      }
      return;
    }

    // ── 阶段二：安全拦截（仅拦截指纹变更或锚点生成失败） ──
    const outOfScopeErrors = [];
    if (fpMismatch) {
      outOfScopeErrors.push(`[指纹不匹配] 模型变更 (当前: ${currentFp} vs 记录: ${meta?.fingerprint})，需在面板执行完整重建`);
    }
    if (l0FailedFloors > 0) {
      outOfScopeErrors.push(`[L0锚点错误] 有 ${l0FailedFloors} 楼锚点提取失败，属于LLM层错误而非单纯向量损坏`);
    }

    if (outOfScopeErrors.length > 0) {
      console.info('❌ [安全拦截] 检测到超出向量范围的全局异常，已中止操作：');
      for (const err of outOfScopeErrors) {
        console.info(`  - ${err}`);
      }
      toast('❌ 存在超出范围的异常（见控制台），安全拦截已中止', 'error', 8000);
      return;
    }

    // ── 阶段三：全层级异常向量定点清洗（静默无弹窗，纯ID精准删除，绝不截断其他楼层） ──
    const targetL1Floors = [...new Set([...l1DriftFloors, ...l1OutFloors, ...l1CorruptFloors, ...l1UserHiddenResidualFloors])];
    const targetL1VecIds = [...new Set([...l1OrphanVecIds, ...l1StaleVecIds, ...l1CorruptChunkIds])];
    const targetL0AtomIds = [...new Set([...l0DanglingAtomIds, ...l0StaleAtomIds, ...l0FloorMismatchAtomIds])];
    const targetL2EventIds = [...new Set([...l2DanglingEventIds, ...l2StaleEventIds])];

    const hasCorruptToClean = targetL1Floors.length > 0 || targetL1VecIds.length > 0
      || targetL0AtomIds.length > 0 || targetL2EventIds.length > 0;

    console.info(`[Info] 向量状态扫描详情：`);
    console.info(`  - 损坏异常: L1切片楼层=${targetL1Floors.length}, L1坏向量=${targetL1VecIds.length}, L0坏向量=${targetL0AtomIds.length}, L2坏向量=${targetL2EventIds.length}`);
    console.info(`  - 缺漏待补: L1缺切片楼层=${l1MissingChunkFloors.length}, L1缺向量切片=${l1MissingVecChunkIds.length}, L0缺向量原子=${l0MissingAtomIds.length}, L2缺向量事件=${l2MissingEvents.length}`);

    if (hasCorruptToClean) {
      console.info(`[Info] 后台定点清洗异常向量（纯按ID精准删除，绝不截断其他楼层）：`);
      if (l1DriftFloors.length) console.info(`  - L1 正文漂移切片楼层: ${l1DriftFloors.join(', ')}`);
      if (CHECK_USER_HIDDEN_RESIDUAL && l1UserHiddenResidualFloors.length) console.info(`  - L1 手动隐藏残留切片楼层: ${l1UserHiddenResidualFloors.join(', ')}`);
      if (l1OutFloors.length) console.info(`  - L1 越界切片楼层: ${l1OutFloors.join(', ')}`);
      if (l1CorruptFloors.size) console.info(`  - L1 破损切片楼层: ${[...l1CorruptFloors].join(', ')}`);
      if (targetL1VecIds.length) console.info(`  - L1 孤儿/过期/破损向量数: ${targetL1VecIds.length}`);
      if (targetL0AtomIds.length) console.info(`  - L0 孤儿/过期/错位向量数: ${targetL0AtomIds.length}`);
      if (targetL2EventIds.length) console.info(`  - L2 孤儿/过期/指纹不符事件数: ${targetL2EventIds.length}`);

      // 1. 清洗 L1（真正的纯 ID 定点批量清洗，绝不截断任何正常楼层！）
      const chunksToDeleteKeys = [];
      const chunkVectorsToDeleteKeys = [];

      // A. 处理越界楼层 (floor >= chat.length)
      if (l1OutFloors.length > 0) {
        for (const f of l1OutFloors) {
          const list = storedChunksByFloor.get(f) || [];
          for (const c of list) {
            chunksToDeleteKeys.push([chatId, c.chunkId]);
            chunkVectorsToDeleteKeys.push([chatId, c.chunkId]);
          }
        }
        if (meta && meta.lastChunkFloor >= chat.length) {
          await cs.updateMeta(chatId, { lastChunkFloor: Math.max(-1, chat.length - 1) });
        }
      }

      // B. 处理手动隐藏残留楼层、正文漂移楼层、破损切片楼层（仅收集具体楼层的具体 chunkId）
      const specificL1Floors = [...new Set([...l1UserHiddenResidualFloors, ...l1DriftFloors, ...l1CorruptFloors])];
      for (const f of specificL1Floors) {
        const list = storedChunksByFloor.get(f) || [];
        for (const c of list) {
          chunksToDeleteKeys.push([chatId, c.chunkId]);
          chunkVectorsToDeleteKeys.push([chatId, c.chunkId]);
        }
      }

      // C. 处理孤儿 / 过期 / 破损 chunkVector
      for (const id of targetL1VecIds) {
        chunkVectorsToDeleteKeys.push([chatId, id]);
      }

      // 执行定点批量删除
      if (chunksToDeleteKeys.length > 0) {
        const uniqueChunkKeys = Array.from(new Set(chunksToDeleteKeys.map(([_, id]) => id))).map(id => [chatId, id]);
        await chunksTable.bulkDelete(uniqueChunkKeys);
      }
      if (chunkVectorsToDeleteKeys.length > 0) {
        const uniqueVecKeys = Array.from(new Set(chunkVectorsToDeleteKeys.map(([_, id]) => id))).map(id => [chatId, id]);
        await chunkVectorsTable.bulkDelete(uniqueVecKeys);
      }

      // 2. 清洗 L0（定点删除异常原子向量）
      if (targetL0AtomIds.length > 0) {
        await ss.deleteStateVectorsByIds(chatId, targetL0AtomIds);
      }

      // 3. 清洗 L2（定点删除异常事件向量）
      if (targetL2EventIds.length > 0) {
        await cs.deleteEventVectorsByIds(chatId, targetL2EventIds);
      }
      console.info('[Info] 异常向量定点清洗完成');
    } else {
      console.info('[Info] 未发现任何损坏向量，跳过清洗');
    }

    // ── 阶段四：纯后台底层静默补齐缺漏（对齐官方离散定点补洞） ──
    console.info('[Info] 正在执行全层级向量缺漏补齐（纯后台）...');

    // 1. 补齐 L1 切片与向量（对齐官方 repairMissingChunks，离散空洞补齐）
    let l1Repaired = 0;
    let l1NewChunks = [];
    try {
      const l1Res = await crp.repairMissingChunks({
        chatId,
        chat,
        vectorConfig: vectorCfg,
        onProgress: (done, total) => {
          l1Repaired = done;
        },
      });
      l1Repaired = l1Res?.repaired ?? l1Repaired;
      l1NewChunks = l1Res?.chunks || [];
      console.info(`[Info] L1 切片与向量检查完成，本次补齐切片数: ${l1Repaired}`);
    } catch (e) {
      console.info(`[Warn] L1 后台补齐遇到非致命错误: ${e?.message || e}`);
    }

    // 2. 补齐 L0 状态向量（对齐官方 vectorizeMissingStateAtoms，离散原子补齐）
    let l0Repaired = 0;
    try {
      const l0Res = await si.vectorizeMissingStateAtoms(
        chatId,
        (done, total) => {
          l0Repaired = done;
        },
        { vectorConfig: vectorCfg }
      );
      l0Repaired = l0Res?.vectorized ?? l0Repaired;
      console.info(`[Info] L0 状态向量检查完成，本次补齐向量数: ${l0Repaired}`);
    } catch (e) {
      console.info(`[Warn] L0 后台补齐遇到非致命错误: ${e?.message || e}`);
    }

    // 3. 补齐 L2 事件向量（对齐官方 collectMissingEventVectorPairs，离散事件补齐）
    let l2Repaired = 0;
    let toVectorizeEvents = [];
    try {
      const curEvVecs = await cs.getAllEventVectors(chatId);
      const curEvVecMap = new Map(curEvVecs.map(v => [v.eventId, v]));
      toVectorizeEvents = events.filter(e => e?.id && evi.buildEventVectorText(e) && !curEvVecMap.has(e.id));

      if (toVectorizeEvents.length > 0) {
        console.info(`[Info] 正在为 ${toVectorizeEvents.length} 个事件生成 L2 向量...`);
        const texts = toVectorizeEvents.map(e => evi.buildEventVectorText(e));
        const embeddings = await emb.embed(texts, vectorCfg);
        const records = cs.makeEventVectorRecords(
          chatId,
          toVectorizeEvents.map((e, idx) => ({
            eventId: e.id,
            vector: embeddings[idx],
            sourceHash: dg.inputDigest('event', texts[idx]),
          })),
          currentFp
        );
        await cs.saveEventVectors(records);
        l2Repaired = records.length;
        console.info(`[Info] L2 事件向量补齐完成，生成向量数: ${l2Repaired}`);
      } else {
        console.info('[Info] L2 事件向量无缺漏');
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.info(`[Warn] L2 后台补齐遇到非致命错误: ${e?.message || e}`);
    }

    // ── 阶段五：词法索引定点增删维护（毫秒级离散更新，绝不全量推倒重构） ──
    try {
      const removedL1Floors = [...new Set([...l1UserHiddenResidualFloors, ...l1DriftFloors, ...l1CorruptFloors, ...l1OutFloors])];
      const hasLexicalMutations = removedL1Floors.length > 0 || l1NewChunks.length > 0 || targetL2EventIds.length > 0 || toVectorizeEvents.length > 0;

      if (hasLexicalMutations) {
        console.info('[Info] 正在执行词法索引定点增删维护...');

        // 1. 定点移除受影响楼层的旧切片文档
        for (const f of removedL1Floors) {
          lex.removeDocumentsByFloor?.(f, chatId);
        }

        // 2. 定点移除受影响事件的旧文档
        if (targetL2EventIds.length > 0) {
          lex.removeEventDocuments?.(targetL2EventIds, chatId);
        }

        // 3. 定点增量添加新补齐的切片文档
        if (l1NewChunks.length > 0) {
          lex.addChunkDocuments?.(l1NewChunks, chatId);
        }

        // 4. 定点增量添加新补齐的事件文档
        if (toVectorizeEvents.length > 0) {
          lex.addEventDocuments?.(toVectorizeEvents, chatId);
        }

        // 获取最新索引状态
        const curIdx = await lex.getLexicalIndex?.();
        const docCount = curIdx?.documentCount ?? 0;
        console.info(`[Info] 词法索引定点增删维护完成 (注销楼层=${removedL1Floors.length}, 新增切片=${l1NewChunks.length}, 当前有效文档=${docCount}篇)`);
        toast(`✅ 词法索引定点维护完成 (${docCount}篇)`, 'success', 3000);
      } else {
        const curIdx = await lex.getLexicalIndex?.();
        const docCount = curIdx?.documentCount ?? 0;
        console.info(`[Info] 词法索引与当前数据100%一致，无需增删 (当前有效文档=${docCount}篇)`);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.info(`[Warn] 词法索引定点维护异常: ${e?.message || e}`);
    }

    // ── 阶段六：汇总汇报 ──
    const summaryItems = [];
    if (l1Repaired > 0) summaryItems.push(`L1切片/向量: ${l1Repaired}`);
    if (l0Repaired > 0) summaryItems.push(`L0向量: ${l0Repaired}`);
    if (l2Repaired > 0) summaryItems.push(`L2事件: ${l2Repaired}`);

    const summaryText = summaryItems.length > 0 ? summaryItems.join(', ') : '数据无缺漏';
    console.info(`[Info] 向量自动化修复全流程圆满结束 (${summaryText})`);
    toast(`✅ 向量修复完成 (${summaryText})`, 'success', 5000);

  } catch (err) {
    console.info(`[Error] 向量后台自动修复遇到未捕获异常: ${err?.message || err}`);
    toast(`❌ 自动修复遇到异常: ${err?.message || err}`, 'error', 8000);
  } finally {
    window.__LWB_VECTOR_AUTO_REPAIRING__ = false;
  }
})();
